args.command: cd /root/nanobot-src && ps aux | grep -E "nanobot|python.*main" | grep -v grep

# Check if nanobot is installed editable or from source
pip show nanobot 2>/dev/null | head -5 && echo "---" && which nanobot && echo "---" && nanobot --version 2>/dev/null || echo "no version flag"

# Check if it's an editable install
pip show nanobot 2>/dev/null || pip3 show nanobot 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && python3 -c "import nanobot; print(nanobot.__file__)"

# Find where nanobot package is actually installed
find /usr/local/lib -name "nanobot" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -5 && echo "---" && find /usr/local/lib -path "*/nanobot/tools/forget.py" 2>/dev/null | head -3

# Check if the installed version matches our source edits
diff /root/nanobot-src/nanobot/tools/forget.py /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nanobot/tools/forget.py 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "=== tool_loop ==="
diff /root/nanobot-src/nanobot/groupchat/orchestra/tools/tool_loop.py /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nanobot/groupchat/orchestra/tools/tool_loop.py 2>/dev/null | head -30

# Check if it's a symlink or editable install
ls -la /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nanobot/tools/forget.py && echo "---" && python3 -c "import nanobot.groupchat.orchestra.tools.tool_loop; print(nanobot.groupchat.orchestra.tools.tool_loop.__file__)"

# Find the actual installed location
find /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nanobot -name "forget.py" 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && python3 -c "import nanobot.tools.forget; print(nanobot.tools.forget.__file__)"

# Restart nanobot gateway
kill 2288882 && sleep 2 && nanobot gateway &
sleep 3 && ps aux | grep nanobot | grep -v grep
